description: Rupa & Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, sells, and distributes hosiery products in knitted undergarments, casual wears, and thermal wears for men, women, and kids in India and internationally. The company offers athleisure products, including loungers, joggers, gym vests, and t-shirts; winter wears, such as sweatshirts, upper and lower thermals, hoodies, and jackets; inner wears comprising briefs, drawers, trunks, boxers, vests, bras, panties, camisoles, and shapewears; outer wears, which include barmudas, lowers, capris, shorts, leggings, t-shirts, tank tops, night wears, co-ord sets, and infant wears; and accessories, such as socks, towels, handkerchiefs, and rainsuits. It also generates power through windmill; and provides contract manufacturing services. The company sells its products under the Frontline, Macroman M-series, Macrowoman W-series, Femmora, Torrido, Thermocot, Colors, Bumchums, Macroman Original, Peek-A-Boo, Footline, Rupa Rainsuit, Jon, Softline, Euro, and Zenzi brand names through traditional retail, modern trade, exclusive and multi-brand outlets, and digital and quick commerce. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Kolkata, India.
